_what: Per-kit config for the JOIN-1 sprite-cell renderer: the GD EoR WARLORD (the dark knight, E1 FINAL K): a two-handed mace in the Mixamo great-sword grip, 1.96 m. Arena push R-C9-132/133. Blitz uses the run cell; buffs and summons use the warcry cell. Rev eor2: body re-pointed to wl_e1/export/final_k_eor2 (the extended-arm spin); eor_spin_start/* and eor_spin_loop/* re-rendered (pass p2), the other 56 cells carried (their clips byte-identical). Rev eor3 (R-C9-141): body re-pointed to wl_e1/export/final_k_eor3 (the helm-crown notch removed: the body's crown tucked under the helm shell); a NEW pack root join1_pack/gd-eor-warlord-eor3, every cell re-rendered; pack roots are immutable, so join1_pack/gd-eor-warlord (eor2) stands as declared.

h_model.method: rest pose, the body mesh (char1) skinned at rest by the runtime importer: crown (max up) minus sole (min up), metres

eor_spin_start.skill: EoR (Eye of Reckoning) spin, the start: 0.2 s, accelerates to 1200 deg/s through 120 deg

eor_spin_loop.skill: EoR (Eye of Reckoning) spin, the loop: one CCW revolution in 0.3 s, in place

warcry.skill: War Cry (power up); buffs and summons use this cell

attack.skill: the one swing cell (great sword slash 3)

eyes._what: his runtime eye billboards rendered INTO the cells (render_cells.gd _eyes); steady, no flicker

main_grip._what: the mace grip = the right FIST in every state: RightHand + the weapon_r seat measured at rest in RightHand's normalised frame (metres). Identical to the weapon_r joint in the 7 non-spin clips (weapon_r is fixed in the hand there); in eor_spin_start/loop (final_k_eor2) the haft slide (e54) moves weapon_r 0.2 m off the fist, so weapon_r is no longer the grip. Was bone weapon_r until 2026-10-02

main_tip._what: the mace head's far point: weapon_r + 0.9251 m along +Y (measured off wl_mace.glb in the bone's frame)

chest._what: the chest: Meshy's "Spine" is the TOP spine joint (parent of neck and both shoulders; Spine02 is the LOWEST, child of Hips). Was Spine02 (belly height) until the socket fix of 2026-10-02

cape: the cape's spring-bone secondary motion (gear_stills.gd _cape_sim) is a runtime simulation and is NOT in the cells: the cape rides its bind (rigid chain)

supersedes.why: R-C9-141 (Matt): the notch on the top of his helmet read as a second eye slit at play distance. Cause: the body mesh's own head (dark brown) pierced the helm piece's crown by up to ~12 mm in a crescent across the front of the dome just above the brow. eor3 tucks the body's crown under the helm shell (positions only); every clip, socket and piece is byte-identical, so the release times are unchanged. The declared eor2 pack is immutable.
